question: What yogic powers arise from this stage of practice?
premises: Knowledge of hearing distant things is mentioned.
These are presented as attained results.
inference: This practice yields distant hearing and the power to paralyze bonds.
uncertainties: pāśa-stobha may mean arresting bonds or immobilizing fetters.
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
